description: The application network is a customer-facing data plane that carries the traffic between deployed workloads, services, and end users.

The management network is an isolated, tightly access-controlled network used to configure, monitor, and orchestrate infrastructure components, separate from the customer-facing data plane that carries actual workload traffic.
The transit network is the interconnection layer that routes traffic between otherwise isolated networks, it acts as the backbone hub rather than carrying workload traffic itself.
the salesforce network connects Hyperforce to a transit network at AWS and acts as the on-ramp for Salesforce's infrastructure.
